description: The organization has not established defined retention periods for personal data as required by GDPR Article 5(1)(e). This signal indicates that data may be kept longer than necessary for its original processing purpose, violating the storage limitation principle. Organizations must define and document specific retention periods for each category of personal data processed.
applicability: Organizations processing personal data of EU residents, Data controllers and processors subject to GDPR, Organizations without documented data retention policies

metadata.detection_notes: Detection involves reviewing data retention policies, checking for documented retention schedules, and assessing whether retention periods are defined for all categories of personal data.

name: Data Retention Periods Not Defined
